title: Nonlocal problems for Laplace equation in Bochner spaces
summary: We study the Laplace equation posed in the unbounded rectangular domain $Π= I \times (0,\infty)$ with $I= (0,2π)$, and subject to nonlocal boundary conditions on $\partial Π$ in the trace sense. The analysis is carried out in the Bochner-Sobolev space $W^2_{p,1}(Π;X)$, associated with the Bochner space $L^{p,1}(Π;X)$, with $ p \in (1,\infty)$ and $X$ is a suitable Banach space. To solve the problem, we employ a generalized spectral method.
